edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: The repeated what clauses, seeing/hearing/touching, manifested life, fellowship, walking, light/darkness and confession remain. Our joy in 1:4 and Jesus His Son without an added Christ in 1:7 follow the consulted wording. Cleanses is modern third-person English; every sin and plural our sins remain distinct. All unrighteousness in 1:9 uses natural English for the mass noun.

chapters.decision: Ordinary you and modern verbs restored. Advocate and propitiation remain provisional inherited terms, with the whole world clause kept intact. The old/new commandment, repeated I write/I have written, little children/children/fathers/young men, last hour/antichrists, and abiding/anointing language remain. All of you know in 2:20 is not changed to you know all things. The long 2:27 sentence is repunctuated for spoken clarity without deleting its truth/no-lie contrast.

chapters.decision: Modern verbs restored while the children, birth, seed, abiding, death/life and closed-heart images remain. Children in 3:7 reflects paidia, distinguished from little children/teknia in 3:18. This world’s goods smooths the means-of-living expression in 3:17. Future we will know/reassure is preserved in 3:19. The singular our heart remains in 3:19–21. Does not sin, does not practice sin and cannot sin are retained without inserting habitually as an automatic tense gloss.

chapters.decision: Modern verbs restored. In 4:8 has not come to know expresses the failure to know in natural English, retaining its past/result orientation rather than replacing it with a simple present does not know. God remains the subject of God is love. Only Son, world, abiding, Spirit, complete love and punishment remain. We love in 4:19 has no supplied Him, matching the consulted shorter wording.

chapters.decision: Modern verbs restored; birth/begotten, victory, water/blood and witness repetitions remain. Verses 5:7 and 5:8 keep separate anchors and the consulted shorter wording without the heavenly-witness expansion. The difficult prayer clause in 5:16 is smoothed by committing a sin, retaining its pronouns and distinction of sin leading/not leading to death. All unrighteousness is natural English for the mass noun in 5:17. Keeps himself at 5:18 follows the consulted NA28 reflexive heauton, replacing inherited keeps him. The closing idols warning remains without an added Amen.
